slides.title: 5 Meta AI features already hiding in your apps
slides.sub: No new app to download. It's already there.
slides.voiceover: If you use Instagram, WhatsApp or Facebook, Meta AI is already hiding in there.

slides.label: THE LIST
slides.title: 5 things Meta AI can already do
items: Redraw a Story photo or clip from a text prompt
Generate images in a DM, then ask for changes
Type `@Meta AI` in a chat or use Search
WhatsApp turns your unread chats into bullet points
Businesses can let Meta AI answer customers
slides.voiceover: Here are five things Meta AI can already do, right where you're scrolling.

slides.label: 01 · INSTAGRAM STORIES
slides.title: Restyle turns a photo into a whole new scene
steps: Open a Story
Add a photo or video like you normally would
Tap `Restyle`
It sits at the top of the Stories editor
Type a prompt
"watercolor", "add a crown", "sunset background" — Meta AI redraws it
slides.voiceover: One. Restyle rewrites your Story's whole look from a text prompt.

slides.label: 02 · INSTAGRAM DMs
slides.title: Generate and edit images without leaving the chat
steps: Type `/imagine`
or `@Meta AI imagine` plus what you want, in any DM
Pick a result
Meta AI replies inline with a set of images
Ask for a tweak
"add a hat", "make it night" — Imagine Edit updates it
slides.voiceover: Two. You can generate and edit images without ever leaving the chat.

slides.label: 03 · SEARCH & CHATS
slides.title: Meta AI answers questions right where you're scrolling
steps: Type `@Meta AI`
in any 1:1 or group DM, then ask your question
Or use Search
Instagram's search bar can ask Meta AI directly
Same window, same login
no separate app, no new account
slides.voiceover: Three. Type at Meta AI in any chat, and it just answers.

slides.label: 04 · WHATSAPP
slides.title: Let Meta AI catch you up on unread chats
steps: Tap the unread count
on a chat with messages piling up
Get bullet points
a private summary of what you missed
Off by default
turn it on in Settings › Chats › Private Processing
slides.voiceover: Four. WhatsApp can bullet-point your unread messages for you, if you turn it on.

slides.label: 05 · BUSINESS ACCOUNTS
slides.title: Business pages can let Meta AI handle the replies
steps: Meta Business Agent
answers customers on WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger
Three modes
you write every reply, approve AI suggestions, or let it answer alone
It learns your business
from your Page, past chats and your website
slides.voiceover: Five. A business page can let Meta AI write, suggest, or send the reply itself.

slides.title: Meta AI is already on your phone.
slides.title2: You just have to open it.
